messages.subject: Re: SE of mean in Descriptives
parts:
That's fair. I'll put it on my TODO list, though I don't see myself
getting to it any time soon. What did you enter into the box that
caused a crash? that shouldn't happen.

In the mean time, you can use:

function(x) sd(x,na.rm=FALSE)/sqrt(sum(!is.na(x)))


Ian
